name: Marshall Islands
description: The Marshall Islands from the navigators of the stick charts to German, Japanese and American rule, the nuclear tests and independence in 1986.

checkpoints.name: Navigators and colonists
checkpoints.note: Marshallese sailors crossed the ocean with stick charts. Germany and then Japan ruled the atolls, and America took them in 1944.

checkpoints.name: The nuclear tests
checkpoints.note: The United States tested 67 nuclear weapons at Bikini and Enewetak from 1946 to 1958.

checkpoints.name: Free association
checkpoints.note: The Marshall Islands became self-governing in free association with the United States in 1986.
